name: The Wizards Meet
ability: Each night you and up to ⅓ # of players (rounded up) are chosen at random to cast a spell. At least 1 player of each alignment must cast a spell. They must follow the spellcasting rules.
firstNightReminder: Randomly draw up to ⅓ # of players (rounded up), at least one of these must be evil: ask them and Spellcasting to cast a spell. Spells take effect in order drawn. Spells are no longer than 60 words, named with 1-5 words which cannot contain player or character names, spell names cannot be blatantly dishonest. The names will be announced at dawn and any spells the Storyteller wishes may become a "Dud" making it have no effect. Spells last until the caster dies, they cast another spell, or Spellcasting is no longer in play.
otherNightReminder: Randomly draw up to ⅓ # of players (rounded up), at least one of these must be evil: ask them and Spellcasting to cast a spell. Spells take effect in order drawn. Spells are no longer than 60 words, named with 1-5 words which cannot contain player or character names, spell names cannot be blatantly dishonest. The names will be announced at dawn and any spells the Storyteller wishes may become a "Dud" making it have no effect. Spells last until the caster dies, they cast another spell, or Spellcasting is no longer in play.

name: D&D
ability: Once per game, at dusk, publicly chose up the three players: if they agree, they adventure out of the game until next dusk. The game cannot end while they are adventuring.

name: Magnum Opus
ability: One per game, rack a subgame with a script of your choosing. Something good happens to the people who win the subgame.

name: Arkus
ability: A player makes a rule that the apposing team must follow?

name: Whale Bucket
ability: On your first night, choose any amount of characters. You learn how many are in play. If you choose more than 3 you may learn one more or one less than reality.
firstNightReminder: Whale Bucket chooses any amount of characters. Give according number.

name: Lizard
ability: On your first night, choose up to two non-townsfolk characters, gain a mutation of their abilities. You know your ability.

name: Small Pony
ability: Each night, choose a player, learn something about their character.
firstNightReminder: The Small Pony chooses a character and learns an aspect of their character.
otherNightReminder: The Small Pony chooses a character and learns an aspect of their character.

name: Quantum
ability: Each night, select a character aspect you wish to possess (once).
firstNightReminder: Wake in accordance to the Quantum laws.
otherNightReminder: Wake in accordance to the Quantum laws.

name: ✸§†⸸⁂֎¬╦★♄✦⧓ξ灯
ability: Each night, choose a player: learn how many times their ability has been used and how many times the player chose to use it.
firstNightReminder: ✸§†⸸⁂֎¬╦★♄✦⧓ξ灯 chooses a player. Show them a number.
otherNightReminder: ✸§†⸸⁂֎¬╦★♄✦⧓ξ灯 chooses a player. Show them a number.

name: Orchestral Suite
ability: Each night*, choose a player: 1) they act twice tonight or, 2) they regain their ability until dusk.
otherNightReminder: Orchestral Suite choose a player: that player either acts twice tonight or regains their ability until dusk.

name: Fall of Rome
ability: Each night*, learn each character type that publicly asked if Rome has fallen.
otherNightReminder: Wake Fall of Rome and give a number.

name: The One Ring
ability: Each night*, whoever holds The One Ring chooses a player: that player gains The One Ring's ability. Something good might happen to whoever holds the ring. [No-one is The One Ring]
otherNightReminder: The ringbearer chooses a player. Something good might happen.

name: D&D
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a Dungeons and Dragons class, race, monster, item, or spell. You gain an ability related to it, you know what it is.
firstNightReminder: D&D might choose an option. Tell them their ability. Possibly wake due to their new ability.
otherNightReminder: D&D might choose an option. Tell them their ability. Possibly wake due to their new ability.

name: The Tri-state Area
ability: Twice per game, on separate days, you may make an -inator

name: Oops All!
ability: All Oops All! have the ability of a different character: you know it. [+0 to +2 Oops all!. 1 of the extras might be drunk or evil]
firstNightReminder: Wake and inform the Oops All!'s of their character. Wake if needed.

name: Dragon ball Z
ability: If you are executed, you only die if you lose a game of roshambo against your nominator.

name: Those yet to Come
ability: An evil player chooses your ability: you know it.
firstNightReminder: Wake an evil player. Tell Those yet to Come their ability. Wake if needed

name: All those Lost
ability: On your first night, choose up to 3 players: some amount of words are removed from or added their abilities. You know the total amount of words.
firstNightReminder: All those Lost chooses 3 players. Change their ability. Show All those Lost a number.

name: Eternal War
ability: Eternal War is the alignment of the most recent execute.
otherNightReminder: Inform Eternal War of their alignment.

name: Emotions
ability: You don't know you are Emotions. You think you are a minion, but you're not.

name: Spoof
ability: You have a spoof version of the ability of another character. You may or may not know your ability.

name: Djinn
ability: On your first night, you may make 1 game rule.

name: Pirate
ability: Each night, choose an alive player: the demon can choose to gain their ability until dusk and that player is drunk until dusk.

name: Lovecraft
ability: Each night, choose two players: if something would happen to them, you can choose to have it happen to you instead.
firstNightReminder: Lovecraft selects two players. If something happens to them, wake Lovecraft and ask if they would like it to happen to them instead.
otherNightReminder: Lovecraft selects two players. If something happens to them, wake Lovecraft and ask if they would like it to happen to them instead.

name: Ragnarök
ability: If you are executed & die, your 2 living townsfolk neighbors are poisoned.

name: Trouble Brewing
ability: Each night*, chose a player: they die. The 1st evil player this kills causes someone to become their character and evil.
otherNightReminder: Trouble Brewing chooses a player. If evil, a new player becomes that evil character.

name: Bad Moon Rising
ability: Each night*, choose any amount of players: they die. The more you chose, the higher the chance something bad for the evil team might happen.
otherNightReminder: Bad Moon Rising chooses a player. Something bad might happen to the evil team.

name: Sects & Violets
ability: Each night, choose up to two players: they are 'mad' by a character of your choosing or they are executed that night. If none break, both of them die that night.
firstNightReminder: Sects & Violets chooses up to 3 players and a 'madness' related character. Inform chosen player what they are mad about.
otherNightReminder: Sects & Violets chooses up to 3 players and a 'madness' related character. Inform chosen player what they are mad about. Possibly kill players.
